definition.force_operation: the correct operation pointer at every step INSIDE the true chain; subject and stop are the model's own greedy choices, and beyond the true length nothing is forced
definition.force_operation+subject: both pointers forced inside the true chain; only stopping is free
definition.force_stop: CONTINUE until the true chain length then STOP, for steps inside the true chain only; others free
definition.force_subject: question position 1, then the most recent result, for steps inside the true chain only; operation and stop free

note_on_v4: force_subject points at the most recent result SLOT.  That is an evaluator-side instrument, not a model feature: the model itself has no recency flag in the --learned-register arms.
